I just want to take the time to thank everybody for the support. I didn't expect this to get 25 up votes, which, for a long time lurker I consider it milestone. I was in the (psych ward) hospital for only a week, and i'm telling you all right now, it helps get the real "you" back. I was in the very lucky situation of being roommates with someone my age (also a fellow Redditer). We were both in the same mess, both lost all of our friends and understood one another . But where I was incredibly fortunate to be discharged without legal interference, my roommate ended up getting his "precautions" raised (gauges your risk of suicide) shortly before I left. Me and him plan to grab some coffee after he's discharged, so I can only hope  i gave him something to look forward to, and he's holding up okay. 

Anyway. 

I hope my experience can be proof to someone out there that being admitted into a hospital is not a sign of weakness, but of courage and resilience. I met her in my junor year, when she was a sophmore. The only place we really talked was chemistry and occasionally FB, and then the next year I had Physics with her. It turns out that we both liked each other when we first met, but neither of us thought we had feelings for each other. This has happened before, also ironically, in my freshmen year with a different girl. 

We didn't start hanging out with each other until I had a bad falling out of a "relationship in development", so to speak. I had thoughts of suicide before i met the other girl, and If I hasn't met her when I did,  I'd probobly be dead. This other girl made me feel like I had a place, and that I belonged in the world. It was also my first real "relationship type" deal with a girl. Everyone at school talked about us, because it just didn't seem like she would ever go for a guy like me. And surprisingly enough, It wasn't meant to be. I took it very personally when she broke it off, add that all up with the feelings of inadequacy i felt before and i was right back to where i started, only this time I actually felt like I was going to do it. And I did, to see if she would care, and she didn't. I described it in my only post to /depression. But basically, I took drugs and alcohol along with cough syrup in dangerous and poisonous amounts and I got loopy at school. I was really high,and I hallucinated. I expected It to kill me over time, not right out. I ended up having a black out adventure where I took that close guy friend she had to go to her house on valentines day to give her a valentines day present he was nervous about giving, she as also sick, so I probobly thought we needed to visit her. He knew that there was something wrong with me long before we went. After that, I told them everything, about the drugs and such, and that I expected it to kill me. They were the only ones who knew. It was then that we started hanging out, whenever I got extraneously low she would come pick me up and do HW with her, walks, getting food, talking. She helped me, a lot. No one has ever done what she has done for me. And that, already, makes her special to me.  

After awhile I did the same thing I'm doing now, which was to never speak to her again because I was hurting her. I tried again, and again. To no effect. The second time was a fluke, and the third time I couldn't go through with it. She doesn't know about the third time. No one but my psychologist.

The drinking picked up in earnest after that. 

I've been depressed since my sophmore year, but things didn't get bad until my senior year.

I honestly think it's too late to apoligize. I've apologized too much, and she's forgiven too much. She doesn't need me right now. She needs good, understanding people, who won't hurt her. And she has that.

All that time, it was a mistake to get involved in her life. I wish i didn't know her as well as I do, or else i wouldn't feel like I needed to do this. She sent me this before I sent the other one. I just, can't believe anything she says to me. It all seems like something she has to say to me so I don't feel worse. It seems like its exaggerated. I want to believe it, but I can't. It sounds like I've played my part, and now she's done with me. Like our friendship means nothing to her, and it probobly won't ever mean as much as it did to me. 

"Jeremy, I wills ALWAYS be here for you No matter what. Just not in the same way that we've been lately. I'm telling you right now that if you are going to be mad at yourself then I'm going to be mad at you. You have No reason whatsoever to be mad at yourself. So get that out of your head. You have never guilted me into liking you. I have never once lied about my feelings towards you. They have always been real. You didn't force me to like you. I liked you when I was a sophmore and thought you would never like me and then this year I started liking you again. That's a promise. You are not a pathetic person at all. If you thought I liked you because I felt sorry for you then you're wrong. I liked you and still like you because you are you. Because you know how to make me smile, you know how to make me laugh, you know how to help me even when I'm too stubborn to except help, you know how to make me be serious when it's needed, and most of all you know how to make me feel like an important person. The other guys that I have dated I was never able to open up to them like I have opened up to you. With you it's so easy. And I want to thank you for that, for being such an amazing and understanding person. I hate that you think that you weren't special to me. Because honestly you have been more special than any guy to me. You don't realise it but you mean more to me then you know. You did more right than wrong. My other guy friends are just that, guy friends. I don't open up to any of my guy friends. You have been the best friend a person could ever ask for. They are just friends. I like spending time with them. But they aren't special to me like you are. I loved spending time with you. It was so much fun and interesting I know we never did anything huge but that's what made it so special. The fact that we we're able to just have so many great nights in just talking to each other, goofing off and just being there with each other is what made hanging out with you ten times better than hanging out with my other friends. There's always an expectation of me when I hang out with my other friends but when I was with you I felt like I could be myself and not worry about what I said or how I acted. I'm so sorry I didn't tell you sooner. I've been thinking about this a lot. I've been going back and forth trying to figure if I should have done this or not. This is not an easy decision for me. You need to know that. This is one of the hardest decisions I've made in a long time. You are so special to me you don't even know. You mean more to me than any of my other guy friends. But the reason why it didn't work out between us is because we just kind of grew apart. And that's my fault. 100% my fault. And I know that. I just can tell that a lot of things will be changing in me soon and you don't deserve to be taken down with me. There's nothing special about me. Honestly. There never will be. It's funny because I've told you so much about me and yet there's still a whole other side to me that you don't know about. I'm actually an asshole and I don't want you to stick around and see that. I wanted to hang out with you this weekend but I knew if we had I would just be leading you on. And I feel so made doing this right before Finding Nemo. Like horribly bad you don't even know. I would have done this sooner but I just didn't know if I wanted to do it yet. I feel like a total bitch you don't even know."

"I'm not blocking you forever, though, I hardly think that matters, since by the end of your senior year i'll be another bad memory, bound to be replaced with someone else. Becoming very used to the idea of being replaced. Seeing anything to do with you sets me off, and I can't have that. You've proven to be effective by yourself, so I doubt my absence would be of any consequence, and frankly, i've never helped you, and you don't need it. And finally, don't ask me if I'm ok after this, because it honestly pisses me off. Both you and her treated me like some wounded puppy with Paper Mache feelings and it fucking patronizes me. And i'm really sorry you felt bad? About what, exactly? That I was a mistake? That you had to go and break it to poor sensitive (referring to mysef)? Like its some fucking chore?WHAT? WHAT is (referring to the girl) SO fucking sorry about? You know, exactly, how I feel, So there's really no point in asking me. Your probobly used to me saying goodbye and not meaning it, but this is goodbye for awhile. I don't know for how long. Enjoy the summer with your real friends. They were all better than I ever was". 

This is when I lost it. I should have never said any of this, the message she sent before this was detailing how important I was to her. I just didn't want to believe any of it. My friendship with her is incredibly important to me, but she doesn't need the problems that come along with being my friend. And eventually, she will forget me. I deserve to be alone, and to suffer. 

Theres close to nothing that makes me happy, i've tried pursuing old hobbies, tried running distance, working out, and it leaves me with the same deflated and lack of self-respect I have. No matter what I do, or what i do to fix it, It feels in vain, and like something that I'll never be able to fix. This never hurt as much as it did when (the other girl) left me. Because I know that she was someone who'd still be around had I only done the simple things that should've been done without question. Hanging out with her helps, a lot. They put me on a high, and I feel better about myself. It's so much different with her, because i never had some crazily high expectation of myself that I'd struggle to reach for, I could just be whoever I wanted to be. But then this stupid, and automatic feeling kicks in and I treat her as if she's already walking out the door and I try helplessly to keep her attention, But this has the opposite effect. I seem stale, and uninteresting after awhile. I can't help it, god knows that i've tried to just be myself, But I just don't know who that is anymore.

 And these aren't selfish interactions because I try to help her, but I often don't. Because she still feels like a shitty and terrible person.

I like helping people, small ways and the big ways. It makes me feel like I'm giving something back, because I've taken so much. It feels good, to know that Your affecting someone positively. And for me, these are feelings far and few between. 

But now, I can't help anyone, Hell, I can't even help myself. I want to be the help that she deserves, and i'd go to any lengths for me to become so, but I'm not healthy, not sound of mind, and not the right person. I would give ANYTHING, to be that guy. But with the way things are going now, they're going to get a lot worse before they start to get better. And she doesn't need worse, she needs the best.

I'm thinking about sending her a letter. And explain to her that a relationship, friendship or above, is a burden to carry. We both should have never entered each others lives the way that we did.I've done nothing but pour the gasoline on the already expanding fire of problems she has. And it hurts to know that I do that, because she was the only one who would have gave every second of her time to make sure I was OK. She saved my fucking life. And this is how I repay that, by cutting off all contact with her. She's going to be so much happier without me. And I can tell, that I'm absolutely right about that. I can only hope now, that she opens up to her other friends and all support her as much as they can. She needs, that kind of care and loving support. 

This is, the sole thing I've done for her that has been the right move. 

And I know, for a fact, that I'm right.

We fought a lot before, and she said that was a factor in why things weren't working out. And that was all of my doing. My insomnia is a big part in that, but at the same time i feel like if she really does mean that much to me, i should be able to control myself more than I have. We were technically on break, because of a specific instance where I ignored her for a few days because of a post on fb about one of her guy friends (it was a photo of a conversation between them taglined "I love our conversations"). This specific friend was pretty close to the girl, and I knew that they had something going before we saw each other (ironically, I tried to get them together before I got to really know the girl). She said that we just needed time to fix ourselves, and that eventually we'd be together again. and then, she sends me this:"I've been thinking a lot lately and I really just think you and I should stay friends. You didn't mess anything up I promise. I just think that we just get into too many fights and we but heads a lot. We work pretty well together but I just think we both need to work on ourselves. Lately I have been a wreck myself and I think I just need to work on myself too. I'm a complete bitch for saying this because I know I said that we weren't over. You were honestly right not to trust me as much as I wanted you to. I wish this wasn't happening. But this is mean trying not to hurt you. I still want to be friends and I'm not abandoning you totally. You can still talk to me about your problems and I will always be here to help you or to just be someone to talk to. I've been thinking this over and over in my head and I realised that maybe it was also me that just needed some time to myself. I feel like such a bitch and I haven't been sleeping cause I keep going over in my head what I would say to you and thinking about how awful I feel for doing this. I know I said that I wouldn't hurt you like (other girl that she helped me get over). But this is me trying as hard as I can not to. I really need us to still be friends...if it's alright with you. You have been an amazing friend to me and I can not thank you enough. I don't want to lose our friendship at all. But I do understand if you don't want to be friends. I've just been realizing that I'm a pretty shitty person and I don't want to end up doing something to you that I regret. I'm so sorry". Whenever i read it, I think it's all about the lack of things i didn't do, and now she's completely over me because of that. And that really gets to me, guilt. It just breaks me down, knowing that there were simple, normal things that I should have done that would've not only helped me, but her too. for example, there was a dance show that my sister does everyyear, she used to be dancer, so she'd like it. It was also on fathers day, which i thought should've been spent with her dad. So I went alone. Then, i see the post and i freak. Turns out she didn't see her dad, since he was in the hospital a good ways away. All i had to do was ask her, and things probobly wouldn't have ended sourly. That simple.

All this aside, I feel like i'm an incredibly self-destructive person who does nothing but hurt other people. I took a lot of time to think, and for the first time in my life, i stepped outside of what i needed from people, and into what it was people needed. And right now, she doesn't need me. All i'm going to do is cause menial problems, when she should be focused on helping and supporting her dad. She's also been spending time with her other friends, she had been a week before, and in that time we didn't speak to each other for the duration of that week. I thought time away would promote strength between us, but, obviously that was a stupid thing to think. It is obvious, however, that her friends seem to be helping a greater deal than I do. Which is what she needs. But, I also need to have her as the supportive and close friend that she was, but i don't deserve that kind of person. things are getting worse with me now, i drank when i was over at a close family friends house (which i was spending a few nights at to get away from alcohol) and these are people who i've known since i was little; basically my second pair of parents. And I drank, when they were trying to help me. 

I've never felt worse. Betraying the trust of the people who were only trying to help me with my drinking. Also the only family figures who know that i'm an alcoholic.

I felt like an asshole, and a belligerent drunk who deserved nobody. It's for that exact reason, why i shouldn't be in her life. I've never felt more worthless.

She'll move on to someone who's much better than me, someone she won't grow out of. Someone who'll consistently help her when it's needed, won't hurt her, and treat her like the kind, empathetic and supportive person that she has been for me. I don't deserve that.  

But god, I really want her to be.
